subject: POC summary: 3.8x throughput, 42% latency drop — request to share short endorsement
messages:
From: Alex Martinez <alex@redwood.com>
To: Taylor Nguyen <taylor@glassline.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 14 Apr 2027 10:12:00 -0700
Subject: POC summary: 3.8x throughput, 42% latency drop — request to share short endorsement

Hi Taylor,

Thanks again for running the POC with us last month — the team at GlassLine was great to work with. I wanted to follow up with a concise summary of the outcomes and ask for a quick favor if you're comfortable.

Key results (7-day weighted average vs. your baseline):
- Throughput (requests/min): 3.8x improvement after switching to Redwood batching & KV cache
- Median generation latency: 42% reduction (from 950ms to ~550ms for 256-token prompts)
- Token cost per 1k responses: ~28% lower after using suggested quantization + caching policy
- Error rate: dropped from ~1.6% to 0.3% (fewer OOMs and timeouts during peak)

I've attached the spreadsheet with the week-by-week numbers and the small snippet Marissa drafted as a one-line endorsement (attached as one-liner-endorsement-draft.txt).

Would you be open to two things?
1) A 10–15 second quote we can use in a short case blurb (we can pre-fill and you can edit), and
2) A 20-minute call next week with Marissa (Customer Marketing) to record a quick 1-minute audio clip and confirm attribution (company name + role).

If it's easier, feel free to send a one-liner back by reply and we'll treat that as permission to use it along with GlassLine's logo.

Thanks — and happy to answer any follow-ups on the numbers.

Best,
Alex Martinez
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
 alex@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0162

Attachments: glassline-poc-kpis.xlsx (spreadsheet), one-liner-endorsement-draft.txt (suggested attribution)

From: Taylor Nguyen <taylor@glassline.ai>
To: Alex Martinez <alex@redwood.com>
Cc: Priya Shah <priya.shah@glassline.ai>
Date: Wed, 14 Apr 2027 13:04:00 -0700
Subject: Re: POC summary: 3.8x throughput, 42% latency drop — request to share short endorsement

Alex — thanks for the clear recap and for the spreadsheet, looks good from our side. Brief answers below and one small edit in the draft endorsement.

On the asks:
- One-liner: happy to provide a one-line. Suggested edit: "Redwood reduced our inference latency and cut per-response cost materially — enabling us to ship a higher-quality feature to customers faster."
- Call: we can do 20 minutes on Tue 4/20 at 11am PT with Priya joining.

Approval notes: I need to run any published quote by Legal for trademark/logo use. I'll initiate that thread after our call; shouldn't be an issue but wanted to flag.

Quick question: did the cost figures include network egress for our EU region tests? I assume the attached workbook has region-tagged rows; we'll double-check.

Thanks,
Taylor
Director of ML Engineering, GlassLine
